name: Classic
blurb: The first four, on a pinball table: a ribbon through the pillars, a bumper orbit, a pair of flippers and a wall-kick shaft.

games.label: Flow
games.hint: Tap or Space in a steady rhythm

games.label: Orbit
games.hint: Tap to fling as the ball crosses the arrow

games.label: Flipper
games.hint: Tap to flip as the ball comes down

games.label: Ricochet
games.hint: Tap to kick off the wall as the ball lands
